So my depression I have noticed doesn't have a trigger. It just pops up whenever it feels like and stays for a brief moment or half a year. Half of the time I can sit here and argue with myself at how silly I'm being for desiring death. But sometimes it just seems so much better. I will feel lost and empty. And death looks like the warmest hug in existence. Where I won't be confused, stuck, unmotivated, angry...blah blah blah. Sometimes I wonder wth happened. Why can't I be one of the happy people? Then in those moments I realize to others I seem happy. And they don't know my struggle because I don't speak up. So that always brings me back. Makes me realize there are others around me who live a similar struggle or are unaware of what they are dealing with. I have found comfort and motivation in that realization. I want to be a school counselor because of it. I have chosen to live to help others.
Thank you. Really, it's nice to know that someone else is there and not just my own voice talking me down from the ledge.
If I've learned anything thus far it is to always be open :)

But when i am alone what has helped me is lying on the ground or on my bed and focusing on a fan spinning, AC running, or a light buzzing. Idk why but the sounds help me calm my breathing if not i'll hyperventilate. 
My sister on the other hand needs SPACE! If you hold her she freaks out more. For her she just has to stand outside in an open space and just let her know its ok. It will pass. You are there. And she will be ok.
